acceptance_criteria.criterion: `menu.sh` contains a valid bash shebang line and changes directory to the project root before invoking PHP.
`menu.cmd` uses `@echo off` and `cd /d "%~dp0"` for Windows-compatible directory resolution.
Both scripts invoke `php tools/menu.php` as their sole action.
`menu.sh` has the executable permission bit set.
Both files have appropriate line endings (LF for `.sh`, CRLF for `.cmd`).
